# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Native rendering refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates Skia m158 fixes for displacement precision and native Vulkan synchronization reporting. The shared HashCode polyfill also switches to OS-generated seeds while preserving per-process hash behavior.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158 maintenance updates** — Incorporates upstream chrome/m158 bug fixes while retaining the same engine milestone. ([#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Bug Fixes

- **Displacement-filter precision** — Uses float precision for displacement scale and offset arithmetic so sampling positions match the filter's float-precision bounds. Displacement colors and channel selectors remain half precision. ([#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))
- **Native Vulkan synchronization reporting** — Synchronous native submission now combines queue-submission success with fence-wait success. Timeout retries, cleanup, and asynchronous behavior remain unchanged. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed result or exception is introduced. ([#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash seeds** — The shared HashCode polyfill now seeds from the operating system random-number generator. Hash codes remain randomized per process and stable within a process; first use now loads System.Security.Cryptography, adding initialization cost. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
